about: House recipes, batch 04 (slice C): written by Claude in a Max-plan session, original, ai-draft. Nutrition is a per-serve estimate kept as data only.

recipes.title: Creamy Polenta with Roasted Garlic and Thyme
recipes.summary: Soft, buttery polenta scented with sweet roasted garlic.
steps: Heat the oven to 190°C. Roast the garlic head drizzled with oil for 30 minutes, until soft and golden.
Bring the stock to a boil, then whisk in the polenta and cook over low heat, stirring, for 20 minutes, until thick and creamy.
Squeeze the garlic into the polenta with the butter, milk and thyme, and stir until smooth.

recipes.title: Orange and Fennel Seed Roasted Beetroot
recipes.summary: Sweet roast beetroot with orange juice and aromatic fennel seeds.
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C. Toss the beetroot with the oil, fennel seeds, orange juice and salt in a roasting tin.
Cover and roast for 30 minutes, then uncover and roast 20 minutes more, until tender and glazed.
Splash with vinegar and scatter over parsley.

recipes.title: Maple Miso Glazed Pumpkin Wedges
recipes.summary: Roasted pumpkin with a sticky sweet and salty miso glaze.
steps: Heat the oven to 210°C. Roast the pumpkin in the oil for 20 minutes.
Whisk the miso and maple syrup with 1 tbsp water, brush over the pumpkin, and roast for 12 minutes more, until sticky and caramelised.
Finish with sesame seeds and spring onions.

recipes.title: Oregano Lemon Roast Potatoes, Athens Style
recipes.summary: Tender roast potatoes soaked with lemon, oregano and garlic.
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C. Toss the potatoes with lemon juice, oil, garlic, oregano and salt in a tin and pour over the stock.
Roast for 60 minutes, turning twice, until golden and the liquid is absorbed.
Rest for 5 minutes before serving so the potatoes soak up the last of the lemony juices.
notes: Use vegetable stock to make it vegan.

recipes.title: Cumin Cauliflower on Garlic Tahini Yoghurt
recipes.summary: Spiced cauliflower under a cooling tahini yoghurt.
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C. Toss the cauliflower with the oil, cumin and salt.
Roast for 28 minutes, until deeply golden and tender.
Whisk the yoghurt, tahini and lemon juice until smooth, spread on a plate, and pile on the cauliflower and parsley.

recipes.title: Coconut Spinach Sambal
recipes.summary: Quick Malaysian style spinach in a fragrant coconut sambal.
steps: Fry the shallots, garlic and chilli in the oil until fragrant and golden.
Add the coconut and toast for 2 minutes until lightly browned.
Stir in the spinach until it wilts, and finish with the lime juice and salt.

recipes.title: Garlic Roasted Mushrooms with Parsley
recipes.summary: Meaty roast mushrooms with garlic and fresh parsley.
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C. Toss the mushrooms with the oil, garlic, thyme and salt.
Roast for 25 minutes, until deeply browned and any liquid has evaporated.
Finish with parsley and lemon juice.

recipes.title: Japanese Cucumber and Wakame Sunomono
recipes.summary: A light vinegared cucumber and seaweed side.
steps: Soak the wakame in cold water for 10 minutes until soft, then squeeze dry.
Salt the cucumber for 10 minutes and squeeze out the water.
Whisk the vinegar, sugar and soy until the sugar dissolves and toss with the vegetables, topping with sesame seeds.

recipes.title: Charred Spring Greens with Anchovy Butter
recipes.summary: Quick charred greens tossed with salty anchovy butter.
steps: Char the greens in a hot dry pan for 4 minutes, until blistered and tender.
Melt the butter with the anchovy, garlic and chilli until the anchovy dissolves.
Toss with the greens and finish with lemon zest.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato Wedges with Smoky Lime Mayo
recipes.summary: Crisp-edged baked wedges with a smoky mayo dip.
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C. Toss the wedges with the oil, paprika, garlic powder and salt.
Roast for 35 minutes, turning once, until crisp at the edges and tender inside.
Stir the mayonnaise and lime juice together and serve for dipping.

recipes.title: Spiced Basmati Pilaf with Toasted Vermicelli
recipes.summary: A fluffy, buttery pilaf with golden noodles and spices.
steps: Toast the noodles in the butter until deep golden, then add the onion, cumin and cinnamon for 5 minutes until soft.
Stir in the rinsed rice, water and salt and bring to a boil until bubbling.
Cover and cook on low heat for 14 minutes, until the water is absorbed. Rest 5 minutes and fluff.

recipes.title: Herbed Couscous with Preserved Lemon and Almonds
recipes.summary: Fluffy couscous studded with preserved lemon and nuts.
steps: Pour the boiling stock over the couscous, cover and leave for 5 minutes until the liquid is absorbed.
Fluff with a fork and stir through the oil, preserved lemon, almonds and herbs.
Taste, and add a squeeze of lemon if it needs more brightness.

recipes.title: Kimchi Egg Stir-Fry with Grated Cauliflower
recipes.summary: A quick low-carb fried 'rice' with kimchi.
steps: Stir-fry the cauliflower in oil for 4 minutes, until dry and lightly golden.
Add the kimchi and soy and fry for 2 minutes.
Push to the side, scramble the eggs until set, and mix through with the sesame oil and spring onions.
notes: Food safety: cook the eggs until fully set.

recipes.title: Braised Fennel-Style Celery with Lemon and Thyme
recipes.summary: Tender braised celery in lemon butter.
steps: Melt the butter in a wide pan and add the celery and thyme.
Add the stock and lemon juice, cover and braise for 20 minutes, until tender.
Uncover and reduce until the liquid glazes the celery.

recipes.title: Fresh Tomato Lime Salsa with Jalapeno
recipes.summary: A fresh chopped tomato salsa with onion, chilli and lime.
steps: Combine everything in a bowl.
Rest for 15 minutes until the juices run and flavours blend.
Serve with corn chips, grilled fish or tacos.

recipes.title: Tahini Garlic Sauce
recipes.summary: A nutty lemony sauce for falafel, grilled veg and wraps.
steps: Whisk the tahini, lemon juice and garlic; it will seize and thicken.
Whisk in the water slowly until smooth and pourable.
Season with salt and refrigerate, where it keeps for 5 days.

recipes.title: Mango and Lime Chutney
recipes.summary: A sweet, tangy chutney for curries, cheese and grilled meat.
steps: Combine everything in a pot and simmer for 30 minutes, stirring, until thick and glossy.
Cool completely, then spoon into a clean jar and refrigerate until needed.
Stir through a squeeze of lime juice before serving.

recipes.title: Peri Peri Sauce
recipes.summary: A fiery Portuguese-African chilli and garlic sauce.
steps: Blend everything until smooth.
Simmer for 8 minutes until the sauce thickens and darkens slightly.
Cool, then pour into a jar and refrigerate.

recipes.title: Blue Cheese Dressing
recipes.summary: A thick tangy dressing for salads and wings.
steps: Mash half the cheese with the sour cream, mayonnaise, buttermilk and lemon juice until mostly smooth.
Fold through the remaining cheese until chunky.
Chill for 30 minutes before serving so the flavour develops.
notes: Vegetarian only with vegetarian blue cheese.

recipes.title: Chipotle Tomato Salsa
recipes.summary: A smoky red salsa with chipotle and roasted tomato.
steps: Char the tomatoes, onion and garlic under a hot grill until blackened in spots.
Blend with chipotle, lime and coriander until slightly chunky.
Season with salt and chill; serve with chips or eggs.

recipes.title: Soy Ginger Dipping Sauce
recipes.summary: A savoury dumpling dip with ginger and black vinegar.
steps: Stir everything until the sugar dissolves.
Let it sit for 5 minutes before serving.
Spoon into small bowls for dipping dumplings or noodles.

recipes.title: Roasted Garlic Aioli
recipes.summary: A rich garlic mayonnaise made with soft roasted garlic.
steps: Heat the oven to 190°C and roast the garlic with oil for 30 minutes, until soft.
Squeeze out the cloves, mash smooth, and mix with the mayonnaise and lemon juice.
Chill for 30 minutes, where the aioli keeps for 4 days.

recipes.title: Lemon Herb Yoghurt Dressing
recipes.summary: A zesty herb dressing for grain bowls and roast vegetables.
steps: Blitz everything until smooth and pale green.
Thin with water until pourable.
Season with salt and chill until ready to serve.

recipes.title: Pickled Ginger and Cucumber Relish
recipes.summary: A bright quick relish for rice bowls, fish and burgers.
steps: Toss the cucumber with the pickled ginger, vinegar and sugar until coated.
Fold in the spring onion and sesame seeds.
Rest for 10 minutes so the cucumber takes on the flavour.

recipes.title: Smoky Baba Ganoush Toast
recipes.summary: Charred eggplant dip spread on warm toast with pomegranate.
steps: Char the whole eggplants over a flame or under a grill for 25 minutes, turning, until blackened and collapsing.
Scoop out the flesh and mix with tahini, lemon, garlic and half the oil.
Toast the bread until golden, spread with the dip and top with pomegranate.

recipes.title: Slow Cooker Style Lamb and White Bean Soup
recipes.summary: A rich lamb and cannellini soup simmered until tender.
steps: Brown the lamb in batches until golden, then set aside.
Soften the onion and carrots, stir in the garlic, tomato paste and thyme.
Return the lamb with the stock and simmer for 80 minutes, until the lamb is tender.
Add the beans for the last 15 minutes.
notes: Food safety: the lamb should reach 70°C and be tender.

recipes.title: Clear Chicken and Ginger Soup with Silken Tofu
recipes.summary: A gentle, comforting soup for when you feel under the weather.
steps: Simmer the stock, ginger and chicken for 15 minutes, until the chicken is white throughout.
Shred the chicken, return to the pot, and add the soy.
Add the tofu and spinach until the spinach wilts.
notes: Food safety: cook the chicken until 75°C and no pink remains.

recipes.title: Cabbage Roll Soup with Paprika
recipes.summary: All the flavour of stuffed cabbage in a soup bowl.
steps: Brown the mince with the onion until no pink remains.
Add the paprika, tomatoes, stock, bay leaf and rice and simmer for 15 minutes.
Add the cabbage for 15 minutes until tender, and season.
notes: Food safety: mince must reach 75°C and rice must be piping hot.

recipes.title: Vegetable Barley Soup with Lemon Zest
recipes.summary: A fresh vegetable barley soup finished with lemon.
steps: Dice the vegetables and simmer with the barley and stock for 40 minutes, until the barley is tender.
Stir in the lemon zest and dill.
Season with salt and pepper and ladle into bowls.

recipes.title: Smoked Haddock Style White Fish Chowder
recipes.summary: A creamy fish chowder with potato and corn.
steps: Soften the onion in butter, then add the potatoes and stock and simmer 12 minutes until tender.
Add the milk and corn and warm without boiling.
Slip in the fish and poach 5 minutes, until opaque and flaking and scatter with chives.
notes: Food safety: cook fish until opaque, flaking and 63°C.

recipes.title: Spiced Pumpkin and Chickpea Soup (Harira Style)
recipes.summary: A Moroccan inspired soup of pumpkin, tomato and chickpeas.
steps: Soften the onion with the spices in oil until fragrant.
Add the pumpkin, tomatoes, chickpeas and stock and simmer for 25 minutes, until the pumpkin is tender.
Finish with lemon juice and coriander.

recipes.title: Hot and Sweet Corn Fritter Breakfast Stack
recipes.summary: Crisp corn fritters with sweet chilli and fried eggs.
steps: Mix the corn, flour, eggs, spring onion and baking powder with salt into a thick batter.
Fry spoonfuls in oil for 3 minutes each side, until golden and set.
Fry the other eggs until the whites are set, then stack with the fritters and drizzle with chilli sauce.
notes: Food safety: cook eggs until the whites are fully set.

recipes.title: Salmon and Soft Egg Rye Breakfast Plate
recipes.summary: Smoked salmon with creamy eggs on dark rye.
steps: Whisk the eggs and scramble gently in the butter for 3 minutes, until just set.
Toast the rye until crisp.
Pile the eggs onto the toast until generous and top with salmon, creme fraiche and dill.
notes: Food safety: cook eggs until fully set; smoked salmon should stay chilled.

recipes.title: Savoury Kimchi Pancake for Breakfast
recipes.summary: A crisp chewy pancake studded with kimchi.
steps: Whisk the flour, water, egg and kimchi into a thick batter and fold in the spring onions.
Heat the oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat until shimmering.
Pour in the batter and fry for 4 minutes each side, until crisp and golden. Serve with soy sauce.
notes: Food safety: cook until the centre is set.

recipes.title: Fresh Ricotta and Lemon Hotcakes
recipes.summary: Light and tender ricotta pancakes with lemon.
steps: Mix the ricotta, eggs, lemon zest and sugar, then fold in the flour and baking powder.
Melt the butter in a frying pan over medium heat.
Cook spoonfuls for 3 minutes each side, until golden and puffed, and serve with maple syrup.
notes: Food safety: cook until the centre is set.

recipes.title: Roast Tomato Bruschetta Breakfast
recipes.summary: Garlic toast loaded with roast tomatoes and basil.
steps: Roast the tomatoes with oil at 200°C for 18 minutes, until burst and sticky.
Toast the sourdough until golden and rub with garlic.
Top with tomatoes, basil and vinegar.
